consequence.statement: Ingresses that cert-manager creates now use pathType `Exact` instead of `ImplementationSpecific`, so the way ingress controllers match their paths may change; the release notes do not say that anything fails.
consequence.remediation: Check that your ingress controller routes `Exact` paths on the Ingresses cert-manager creates as expected.

assertion.statement: In 1.18.0, cert-manager sets the `pathType` of the Kubernetes Ingress it uses to `Exact` instead of `ImplementationSpecific`, so ingress controllers handle it reliably and security is improved.
